honest-review.summary: Two test cases, the same written checks for every setup. v1.1 passed **56 of 56 checks (100%)**, against 100% for v1.0, 68% for design-critique and 64% with no skill. design-critique only switched itself on in 2 of 4 runs.
changes: The verdict must start with one of three fixed labels: Ship, Ship after fixes or Rework.
Every finding needs all three labelled parts, with quoted evidence from the file.
Contrast is measured from the real colours and reported as a ratio.
The score block is always the last thing in the review, and em dashes are banned.
honest-review.method: Method: every setup ran each case in a clean Claude Code session with no other skills installed (`claude plugin eval`), and an independent model graded each run against the same written checks (three votes per check). Runs per setup across both cases: no skill 2, design-critique 4, v1.0 2, v1.1 8. The cases and checks are in the skill’s `evals/` folder on GitHub.
